features.title: Fewer crashes
features.description: We tracked down crashes that only happened in the released app and fixed them across mail, calendar and settings. Unread counts on the taskbar icon show up again too.

features.title: Easier reading with screen readers
features.description: Screen readers now announce the subject, sender and date when you move into a message, then read the mail from the top. Mails made only of images still get a readable text version.
